title: HILUX — Let It Carry Your Load
summary: A Toyota Iraq campaign presenting the HILUX as a dependable partner, built to carry responsibilities and keep every journey moving forward.

blocks.heading: شيّلها حملك
blocks.body:
Built around the idea of strength and responsibility, this Toyota Iraq campaign presents the HILUX as more than a capable pickup truck.

The campaign connects the vehicle's durability with the everyday demands placed on the people who depend on it.

Through cinematic storytelling and relatable situations, HILUX becomes a dependable partner in work, responsibility, and daily life.

blocks.title: HILUX — Let It Carry Your Load | Toyota Iraq Campaign Film

blocks.body: Directed by Rafat Mhalla and Mohammad Jalal

The film translates the campaign's central idea into a human story.

Rather than focusing exclusively on technical specifications, the narrative explores the responsibilities people carry and the role a dependable vehicle can play in supporting them.

This approach allows the product's strength and reliability to emerge naturally through its connection with real-life experiences.

The campaign concept was extended across digital and social communication through portrait-led visuals.

These executions connected HILUX with different professions, responsibilities, and everyday environments while maintaining a consistent campaign message.

As Creative Director at Fikra, I led the creative development process, client communication, and internal coordination.

Working alongside Mohammad Jalal, I helped shape the campaign concept and co-directed the film, ensuring consistency between the original idea, production, and supporting campaign assets.
